name: Cher Mulligan
source: Cher poses as a temporary transferee into Jigen Academy. [spoiler]She is in fact a CIA agent from Washington DC with a mission to eradicate the dimensional invaders[/spoiler]. She immediately earns Mariko's scorn for her reckless driving.
